node.title: Re^5: unable to eval dumped hash (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Perhaps so, but I do not expect that trust to be misplaced.

The issue is that [mod://Safe] is opcode-specific, so it requires knowledge of the Perl internals: what code is compiled to which opcodes, which opcodes should I allow, what does each allowed opcode do, and how have those opcodes changed across Perl versions.

Update: See also the thread [http://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2017/06/msg245124.html|More strongly discourage Safe.pm?] on P5P.
